title: How to Love Difficult People
coreMove: See the fear behind a relative's hard opinion and it stops feeling like an attack, so you can keep loving them and still choose your own life.

exampleSpecs.domain: Source case: Lisa Bilyeu and Frame of Reference
exampleSpecs.audience: Faisal and readers facing frame of Reference
exampleSpecs.stakes: Understanding the lens can loosen the power struggle without giving the other person decision rights.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Show Faisal using Frame of Reference in the source case without controlling another person.

exampleSpecs.stakes: A painful opinion may reflect the other person's fear of loss instead of the true value of the choice.
